verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a note-taking SaaS, but the evidence pack does not document any setting to disable analytics, telemetry, or usage tracking. The nearest item (capacities-docs-16) says AI features are opt-in and that no space data goes to third-party AI services unless AI is activated. That covers AI data sharing, not product telemetry or usage tracking, so it cannot be credited here.
